defaults.quality_specifications: Firm, mature bulbs; 45–65 mm diameter; free from visible rot and excessive surface moisture.
defaults.quality_terms: Independent assessment before pickup; buyer pays
defaults.weighing_terms: Certified scale at pickup and receiving; seller may attend
defaults.partial_acceptance: Allowed only within agreed tolerance or documented grade split
defaults.rejected_produce: Remains seller-owned; seller collects within 24 hours unless buyer or buyer-arranged service is at fault
defaults.exceptions: Severe weather, government restrictions or other events outside either party’s reasonable control; notify the other party promptly and renegotiate first
defaults.dispute_process: Direct discussion, then KisanMitra grievance review and mediation
defaults.additional_terms: Price adjustments require an accepted counterproposal. Verified quality cannot be changed without an evidence-backed reassessment.
